caption: The drawing depicts a four-legged wooden table with a rectangular top that has one side extended outward, resembling a drop-leaf. The table is colored in various shades of light to medium brown, with the wood grain texture visible on its surfaces. The legs are straight and narrow, positioned at each corner of the table, and the extended leaf appears to be supported by the main structure but without visible additional support. The table is centered on a plain, off-white background with no other objects or features present. Subtle shading beneath the table suggests that it is resting on a flat surface.
title: Shaker Drop-leaf Table
